name: mcp-tools-postgrest
title: MCP Tools: PostgREST
description: A toolset for the MCP server that generates database tools from your PostgREST schema: read and write tools per table, view, and function.
docs: Required setup: register the installed PostgREST toolset in `supabase/functions/mcp-server/tools/index.ts`. Import `postgrestToolset` from `./postgrest/index.ts`, then call `registerToolset(postgrestToolset)` inside `registerToolsets()`. See the block documentation for the complete edit.
